title: One recorded holding gain; the day’s trade decisions are not in the record
body_html:
One recorded holding gain; the day’s trade decisions are not in the record

Paper trading · 2026-11-04T17:00:20.731917-05:00

The supplied records show one scheduled run completed and a later daily run failed because its research planner context exceeded a configured limit. That failure is a failure, not evidence of deliberate waiting or a completed decision. No proposal, deterministic risk approval or rejection, submitted order, or actual fill is included, so those parts of the day cannot be reported. The account snapshot shows the paper account at $2,000 cash and equity. The mean-reversion book's recorded MU midpoint supports a small unrealized gain; the other two books' displayed equity matches their starting cash. Book prices are recorded snapshots, not guaranteed closing prices, and book gains exclude fees.

Today's lesson: A marked gain is not a fill

A gain shown on a holding is not automatically a completed trade profit. Here, the recorded midpoint is $29.32 above the $939.88 average purchase price. Across 0.053191 shares, that works out to about $1.56, matching the supplied unrealized gain. No sale or fill record is supplied, so this remains a valuation estimate rather than a realized result.

What the timestamps tell us

The report cutoff is 2026-11-04 22:00:20 UTC. The MU midpoint observation is from 21:59:22 UTC, about 58 seconds earlier. The supplied run records show completion at 13:40 UTC and failure at 20:16 UTC; the completed run has no decision details here. Older performance samples are historical and should not be read as November 4 returns.

What remains uncertain

The strongest recorded caveat for the MU valuation is the quoted range: $800.26 bid to $1,138.13 ask. A midpoint of $969.20 summarizes that range, but the wide gap means it may be a poor guide to an executable price. No investment reasoning is supplied for this holding.

What to watch next

Watch for records that show a proposed order, its deterministic risk outcome, and any broker or simulated fill separately. Also note the timestamp on each new price observation: the current MU midpoint was recorded at 21:59:22 UTC, and the report cutoff was 22:00:20 UTC on November 4. This snapshot is not a guaranteed closing-price feed or a live quote.

Unrealized gain or loss: A position's estimated gain or loss based on its recorded value while it is still held; it is not the same as realized profit from a completed sale.

Bid/ask midpoint: The midpoint between the recorded bid and ask. It is an estimate and does not guarantee that a trade could execute at that price.

Marked equity: An account or book value calculated from cash and recorded holding prices. It can differ from a live or executable value.

Data timing and limitations

Prices come from recorded snapshots, not a guaranteed closing-price feed.
Paper account holdings use the latest recorded snapshot, which may precede fills.
Book marks use observed bid/ask midpoints at price_as_of, not guaranteed live prices. Without an admitted quote the value remains unknown; book gains exclude fees.
Work starting after the cutoff is outside this report. Failures remain labelled.
